text:
Jamal: Heads up — planning a slow-burn deploy tonight 22:00 PT for runtime kv-cache hotfix (runtime v2.3.1). Need canary cohort + smoke owners. If you can take smoke/rollback, please ack and paste checks you'll run.
Sasha: I can own smoke for US regions 22:00–23:00 PT. Will monitor p50/p95, error-rate, and token-drop. @Kevin can you give me the cohort mapping? :thumbsup:
Kevin: I'll be the deployer. I plan to run the canary via the deploy-bot and stay on the runbook. Need exact percents / geo list so I can script the schedule.
Maria: Suggest ladder 3% -> 10% -> 25% with 15m waits. Cohorts: start small global to exercise routing, then split NA/EU/AP for region-specific fallout. Also add a short golden traffic test at +5m after each step.
Jamal: I'm leaning geo-first for this one (kv-cache interacts with regional kernels). Proposed: 5% us-east, 5% us-west, 5% eu-west, pause +15m, then 25% global. If any region shows >1.0% error increase or latency regressions >15% abort.
Kevin: OK. I'll submit schedule like: `/deploy runtime:v2.3.1 --canary "5:us-east,5:us-west,5:eu-west,25:global" --step 15m`. Will post job id when created.
Sasha: For smoke checks I'll run these quick scripts: `scripts/smoke/check-gen.sh` and the perf dashboard query: `service:runtime AND env:prod AND cohort:canary` then check `p95_latency` + `errors`. If anything suspicious I'll post a screenshot and paged timeline.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job created by Kevin at 2024-07-31T05:00:12Z — job_id=deploy-20240731-8249. Canary plan attached.
oncall-bot: reminder to oncall: @SRE oncall rotation for tonight is Sasha. Please confirm you can handle pages until 23:30 PT.
Sasha: confirmed. I'll be oncall and watching alerts.
Jamal: rollback plan (quick):
```
rollback:
  /deploy rollback runtime:v2.3.1 --to runtime:v2.3.0
  # if partial rollback needed: /deploy rollback --cohort us-east
```
Kevin: I'll gate the rollout so each step requires explicit approve — I'll only hit next if Sasha says green. Will also keep logs streaming here.
Maria: FYI I'll do a lightweight post-deploy eval at +30m using the known eval set (evals/kv-cache/regression). Will post results.
Sasha: noted. If I see token-drop or recirc > 2% I'll request immediate rollback.
Kevin: Job created and canary started. Job link: https://deploys.internal/release/deploy-20240731-8249 — ping here when you see step 1 traffic.
deploy-bot: canary step 1 in progress: 5% us-east.
Sasha: step 1 traffic visible. p50 stable, p95 +8% (within threshold). No errors. proceeding to wait window.
Jamal: ack. Waiting for Sasha green to continue to us-west.
Sasha: green for us-west start when ops ready. :white_check_mark:
Kevin: starting 5% us-west now.
deploy-bot: canary step 2 in progress: 5% us-west.
Sasha: us-west looks good. p95 +10% still in bounds. I'll give green for EU.
Kevin: starting 5% eu-west now.
deploy-bot: canary step 3 in progress: 5% eu-west.
Sasha: eu-west shows a small error bump +0.6% tied to a specific kernel; Maria can you run eval on eu samples?
Maria: running eval now, will post output (short).
Maria: eval snapshot: 1200 queries, regressions <0.3% overall. Kernel exception seen in 3 traces, tagging infra.
Sasha: given low impact, ok to proceed to 25% global but hold on full global until we confirm infra patch. Request Kevin to pause after initiating step 4 and wait for my final green.
Kevin: pausing before global step. Holding at pre-global.
Jamal: thanks team. Once Maria's infra tag is triaged we'll reconvene. If anyone sees >1% errors notify immediately and I'll flip rollout to abort.
Sasha: will do.
Kevin: standing by.
